adaptpeptides.com.name: Adapt Peptides
reasons: The PDP presents the product image, price range, strength choices, quantity tiers, and purchase action in one view.
The mobile menu is open by default in the captured state and clips the left edge of the page.
A fixed payment outage notice covers content and announces that card payments are unavailable.
adaptpeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: Keep strength and quantity economics adjacent to the primary action.
adaptpeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: Two persistent overlays obstruct the mobile storefront and reduce purchase confidence.

advancedresearchpep.com.name: Advanced Research
reasons: Desktop homepage and PDP requests were held on a SiteGround connection-security challenge.
One mobile homepage pass rendered only a sparse hero, while the mobile PDP became blank.
No challenge was solved and no store state was inferred.
advancedresearchpep.com.strongestDesignLesson: Security controls need a reliable path for legitimate browsers on every viewport.
advancedresearchpep.com.biggestUXFailure: Public product discovery is inconsistent across desktop and mobile.

agelessvitalitypeptides.com.name: Ageless Vitality Peptides
reasons: The mobile PDP keeps product name, price, strength, stock action, and research-only status easy to scan.
A complete COA is embedded directly below the core product block.
The mobile page becomes very long because the full footer and related products are expanded.
agelessvitalitypeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: Put the actual analytical report in the PDP instead of relying on a generic testing claim.
agelessvitalitypeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: The mobile page is longer than necessary and buries policy navigation in a large footer.

alphacarbonlabs.com.name: Alpha Carbon Labs
reasons: Both desktop and mobile navigations resolved to an empty white page.
No product page could be observed.
alphacarbonlabs.com.strongestDesignLesson: A branded error or maintenance state is better than a silent blank page.
alphacarbonlabs.com.biggestUXFailure: The storefront renders no usable public interface.

alphaomegapeptide.com.name: Alpha Omega Peptide
reasons: The public homepage has a clean responsive hero and testing narrative.
The indexed GLP-3RT product URL redirected to account login and registration.
No account was created, so product and purchase states were not scored.
alphaomegapeptide.com.strongestDesignLesson: A focused scientific hero can communicate quality without crowding the page.
alphaomegapeptide.com.biggestUXFailure: A search-visible product route resolves to account registration instead of the product.

americanpeptides.us.name: American Peptides
reasons: Both homepage and PDP are covered by a researcher and age confirmation modal.
The gate is responsive and clearly explains the research-only boundary.
The confirmation control was not activated.
americanpeptides.us.strongestDesignLesson: A compliance gate should clearly state who may enter and why.
americanpeptides.us.biggestUXFailure: The public product experience cannot be compared without affirming the gate.

aminoclub.com.name: Amino Club
reasons: The only public state is a polished researcher-verification screen.
It requires two affirmative checkboxes before entry.
No attestation was made.
aminoclub.com.strongestDesignLesson: Verification can be concise, legible, and responsive without looking improvised.
aminoclub.com.biggestUXFailure: No public product detail is available for comparison.

aminosequence.com.name: Amino Sequence
reasons: The public homepage is responsive but visually dated.
The products route says Login to View Products.
No account was created and no PDP was available.
aminosequence.com.strongestDesignLesson: A direct product CTA should lead to useful catalog content or explain the access requirement first.
aminosequence.com.biggestUXFailure: The main product CTA creates a login dead end for a new visitor.

apollopeptidesciences.com.name: Apollo Peptide Sciences
reasons: The PDP keeps identity, price, stock, quantity, RUO notice, image, and add-to-cart action together.
A COA thumbnail is visible in the product gallery.
The homepage is overloaded with a very long product grid and the PDP puts a review form before related items.
apollopeptidesciences.com.strongestDesignLesson: Pair a product photo with a readable identity panel and a nearby analytical document.
apollopeptidesciences.com.biggestUXFailure: Long grids and forms make the experience feel heavier than the purchase task requires.

arcticlabsupply.com.name: Arctic Lab Supply
reasons: Homepage and PDP both resolve to the same research-use gate.
Multiple gate images are visibly broken.
The entry action was not used.
arcticlabsupply.com.strongestDesignLesson: A gate should be treated as a production page with the same asset QA as checkout.
arcticlabsupply.com.biggestUXFailure: Broken icons make the first compliance interaction look unmaintained.

ascendingpeptides.co.name: Ascending Peptides
reasons: The PDP is visually distinct and pairs the product with a certificate summary and verification key.
The responsive layout remains coherent and readable.
Price and purchase action are not visible in the initial mobile viewport.
ascendingpeptides.co.strongestDesignLesson: A restrained brand system can make analytical evidence feel central instead of bolted on.
ascendingpeptides.co.biggestUXFailure: The mobile PDP prioritizes a large image over price and action.

ascensionlabs.bio.name: Ascension Labs
reasons: A research-compliance gate covers the storefront.
The retatrutide search route did not produce a product result.
No attestation was made.
ascensionlabs.bio.strongestDesignLesson: Compliance language is easier to absorb when it is grouped into one clear panel.
ascensionlabs.bio.biggestUXFailure: The search URL repeats the homepage state and provides no product-level feedback.

ascensionlabsusa.com.name: Ascension Labs USA
reasons: Both viewports remained on Cloudflare security verification.
The mobile challenge content overflows horizontally.
No challenge was solved.
ascensionlabsusa.com.strongestDesignLesson: Security interstitials must be included in mobile QA.
ascensionlabsusa.com.biggestUXFailure: The only observable mobile state is both blocked and horizontally clipped.

ascensionpeptides.com.name: Ascension Peptides
reasons: The mobile hero is responsive, readable, and has an obvious shop action.
The homepage presents lab-testing and purity claims with a direct COA navigation item.
No public retatrutide PDP was found and the initial load was slow.
ascensionpeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: One strong value proposition plus one clear CTA works well on mobile.
ascensionpeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: Generic testing claims are not connected to a visible batch or product result.

behemothlabz.com.name: Behemoth Labz
reasons: The desktop PDP includes price, strengths, delivery claims, first-party COA, third-party COA, and add-to-cart action.
The mobile PDP collapses into a narrow fixed-width column with most of the viewport left blank.
The homepage navigation and promotional artwork also crowd the mobile viewport.
behemothlabz.com.strongestDesignLesson: Put concrete quality and shipping assurances near the product controls.
behemothlabz.com.biggestUXFailure: The PDP is effectively unusable on a 390px mobile screen.

biolongevitylabs.com.name: Biolongevity Labs
reasons: Both captured viewports were empty white pages.
No current public product state could be inspected.
biolongevitylabs.com.strongestDesignLesson: A fail-safe access page should explain whether the store is gated or unavailable.
biolongevitylabs.com.biggestUXFailure: The public category route silently renders blank.

biopepstore.com.name: BioPep Research Peptides
reasons: A long age and research-use confirmation form covers the storefront.
The mobile modal extends well below the initial viewport before any completion action is visible.
The gate was not completed.
biopepstore.com.strongestDesignLesson: Compliance text should be progressive and the action should remain visible.
biopepstore.com.biggestUXFailure: The mobile gate is too long to scan and obscures its own completion controls.

biopepusa.com.name: BioPep USA
reasons: Homepage and PDP are covered by a 21-plus entry gate.
The mobile PDP can be seen behind the overlay but was not treated as an accessible state.
The entry action was not used.
biopepusa.com.strongestDesignLesson: A short gate with separate enter and exit choices is easier to understand than a legal wall.
biopepusa.com.biggestUXFailure: The product cannot be fairly scored without affirming the gate.

bluumpeptides.com.name: Bluum Peptides
reasons: Homepage and PDP both show the same full-screen age gate.
The gate is visually polished and responsive.
The Yes action was not used, so product and checkout states remain unobserved.
bluumpeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: A gate can preserve premium brand quality on desktop and mobile.
bluumpeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: No public product evidence is visible without interaction.

bulkglp.com.name: BulkGLP
reasons: The PDP exposes actual mass, purity, lot, endotoxin, microbial, and fentanyl results by strength.
Official COA actions are adjacent to the quality table.
The mobile PDP overflows horizontally and a floating cart covers the price area.
bulkglp.com.strongestDesignLesson: Translate every lab report into an immediate, strength-specific proof summary.
bulkglp.com.biggestUXFailure: Horizontal overflow and floating controls damage an otherwise strong mobile product page.

bulkpeptides.com.name: Bulk Peptides
reasons: The public page is covered by a research-use disclaimer and qualified-researcher attestation.
The gate was not accepted.
No product state was scored.
bulkpeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: A gate should have clear agree and disagree actions.
bulkpeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: The modal is text-heavy and blocks product comparison.

compoundsciences.com.name: Compound Sciences
reasons: The mobile PDP clearly presents image, strength, price, short specification list, stock, and add-to-cart action.
The layout is fast and uncluttered.
No batch identity, lab, test date, or COA is surfaced in the product view.
compoundsciences.com.strongestDesignLesson: A simple mobile product stack can outperform a heavily decorated catalog.
compoundsciences.com.biggestUXFailure: The purchase case lacks visible analytical evidence.

corepeptides.com.name: Core Peptides
reasons: The hero is visually coherent and responsive with a clear buy action.
Shipping and support benefits are easy to scan.
No public retatrutide PDP or batch-specific testing evidence was found.
corepeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: A compact benefits row can answer the first shipping, quality, and support questions quickly.
corepeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: The strongest quality claim is generic and not tied to a visible product or lot.

crushresearch.com.name: Crush Research Supply Company
reasons: The mobile PDP makes total price, price per mg, pack economics, current stock, COA access, add-to-cart, and buy-now actions immediately legible.
The site exposes batch pages with lab, date, tested vial count, mass, purity, endotoxin result, and COA.
The fixed mobile navigation overlaps part of the pack selector.
crushresearch.com.strongestDesignLesson: Show per-unit economics, current availability, and the exact proof path before asking for the order.
crushresearch.com.biggestUXFailure: A fixed mobile navigation bar partially covers product options.

epic-pep.com.name: Epic Peptides
reasons: The hero combines product identity, visible lot, purity result, lab accreditation claim, shipping promise, and catalog action.
The public page includes product pricing and add-to-cart actions in a single-page catalog.
No dedicated retatrutide PDP was located in this pass.
epic-pep.com.strongestDesignLesson: Make lot and analytical proof part of the hero, not a footer promise.
epic-pep.com.biggestUXFailure: The single-page structure limits product-specific depth and comparison.

eternaaminos.com.name: Eterna Aminos
reasons: The site explicitly says reference catalog open and ordering disabled.
The responsive page clearly explains that access, documentation, account, and fulfillment systems are still being built.
It is not a comparable active storefront.
eternaaminos.com.strongestDesignLesson: Be explicit when commerce is not live instead of presenting nonfunctional controls.
eternaaminos.com.biggestUXFailure: There is no active purchase path to evaluate.

evopeptidesus.com.name: Evo Peptides
reasons: The product card clearly shows identity, price, stock, rewards, and add-to-cart action.
Research-use status is prominent above the PDP.
The main product media area is blank on both viewports and pushes the mobile action far below the fold.
evopeptidesus.com.strongestDesignLesson: Separate compliance, price, availability, and action into a compact decision card.
evopeptidesus.com.biggestUXFailure: Broken or missing primary media consumes the most valuable PDP space.

expertpeptides.com.name: Expert Peptides
reasons: The desktop PDP has a conventional image, price, stock, quantity, and add-to-cart block.
The mobile layout renders as a narrow desktop column with a large empty area to the right.
The page promotes a mixing help line while providing little visible product-level analytical proof.
expertpeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: Stock and same-day shipping are useful decision signals when kept close to the price.
expertpeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: The responsive layout is broken across the homepage and PDP.

geneticpeptide.com.name: Genetic Peptide
reasons: The mobile PDP presents vial images, strength chips, selected price, quantity, CTA, RUO notice, and analytical thumbnails coherently.
The homepage and product page preserve one consistent design system.
The displayed price range is reversed from $750.00 to $155.00, creating avoidable ambiguity.
geneticpeptide.com.strongestDesignLesson: Strength selection and the resulting price should update in one compact block.
geneticpeptide.com.biggestUXFailure: The reversed price range undermines otherwise clear product economics.

getprimelabs.com.name: Get Prime Labs
reasons: The current destination gives a clear strength matrix, vial-count economics, per-vial price, subscription option, savings, CTA, and testing summary.
Analytical report thumbnails and purity, endotoxin, manufacturing, form, use, and storage summaries are visible.
The original domain redirects to a differently named store and the page presents many simultaneous choices.
getprimelabs.com.strongestDesignLesson: Make bundle economics visual and show the best ongoing and best one-time options side by side.
getprimelabs.com.biggestUXFailure: Brand redirection plus choice density can make identity and selection harder than necessary.

glacieraminos.shop.name: Glacier Aminos
reasons: Both browser passes failed with ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR.
The captured viewport was blank.
No retry bypass or exception was used.
glacieraminos.shop.strongestDesignLesson: TLS availability is a prerequisite for every other conversion optimization.
glacieraminos.shop.biggestUXFailure: The public store was unreachable over HTTPS during the audit.

greatestpeptides.com.name: Greatest Peptides
reasons: The PDP presents current-lot batch number, test date, lab, identity, purity, mass, endotoxin, residual solvent, and water-content results.
Price, stock, delivery, shipping protection, and CTA are visible in the purchase block.
A cookie panel obscures primary mobile content and several product images fail to appear in the long capture.
greatestpeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: A current-lot proof card is more credible than a general COA badge.
greatestpeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: The cookie panel and lazy media obstruct the initial mobile decision state.

heartlandbiolabs.com.name: Heartland Bio Labs
reasons: The homepage turns verification, location, shipping, review volume, and sample COAs into a concise mobile trust story.
The PDP clearly presents product identity, RUO status, HPLC, mass-spec, COA, US-lab, and review signals.
Price and the purchase action sit below the initial mobile viewport and a fixed bottom bar reduces space.
heartlandbiolabs.com.strongestDesignLesson: Use the homepage to compress proof, fulfillment, and reputation into one decision frame.
heartlandbiolabs.com.biggestUXFailure: The mobile PDP delays price and action after a large product image.

hydroresearchpeptides.com.name: Hydro Research
reasons: The homepage requires account sign-in or creation before product information can be browsed.
The product route was blocked by Cloudflare.
No account was created and no challenge was solved.
hydroresearchpeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: If access must be restricted, explain the requirement before collecting credentials.
hydroresearchpeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: The account wall and security block prevent anonymous product evaluation.

ignitepeptides.com.name: Ignite Peptides
reasons: The active 10mg PDP has clear product identity, price, quantity, add-to-cart action, RUO notice, and report thumbnails.
The mobile layout is coherent and preserves the primary decision block.
The site loaded slowly and analytical evidence is represented mainly as small gallery thumbnails.
ignitepeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: Keep the active variant, price, quantity, and CTA together in the first mobile decision block.
ignitepeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: Testing proof is too small to inspect without opening gallery media.

labtrustpeptides.com.name: Lab Trust Peptides
reasons: The PDP presents sale price, stock framing, quantity discounts, COA gallery media, review signal, and add-to-cart action near the top.
The quality section specifies LCMS, heavy metals, endotoxin, sterility, and batch consistency expectations.
The mobile page is text-dense and several homepage product images are blank in the capture.
labtrustpeptides.com.strongestDesignLesson: Use a quality-comparison table to show exactly how verification differs from a generic market claim.
labtrustpeptides.com.biggestUXFailure: Dense copy and lazy image gaps reduce scan speed on mobile.
